title: Implement offline Compliance Ops evidence producer
expected_outcome: A disabled-by-default Node Operator producer validates EvidenceEnvelope v1, applies Compliance Ops allow-lists and size limits, creates stable retry IDs, and builds SigV4 request configuration without endpoint invocation or AWS credentials.
constraints: No API invocation, AWS access, Pod Identity association, endpoint provisioning, secret changes, publish, deploy, or merge.
Do not log payload bodies, authorization material, validator data, or raw reports.

primary_owner.responsibility: contract boundary, retry and SigV4 security decisions
